# html end-to-end: state-only assertions via sngl test --platform=html.


sngl test --platform=html app.sngl
stdout 'PASS'

-- app.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import . "sngl:test"

output { none { html } }

component main node {
    var count = 0
    text(value=string(count))
}

func testInitial(t Test, c main) {
    t.assert(c.count == 0)
}

window {
    main
}
-- testrun/html/none/app.sngl/main/1 --
sha256:dab7a9d2db338bc385cc39444bf5d0ae
{
  "results": [
    {
      "Desc": "Initial",
      "Passed": true
    }
  ]
}
